INDO 100.description: Spoken and written Indonesian. Credit will be granted for only one of INDO 100 or INDO 102.

INDO 101.description: Continuation of INDO 100. Credit will be granted for only one of INDO 101 or INDO 102. Recommended pre-requisite: INDO 100.

INDO 102.description: Spoken and written Indonesian. As of 2011W, credit will be granted for only one of INDO 100/101 or INDO 102.

INDO 200.description: Study of the grammar and introduction to Indonesian literature. As of 2011W, credit will be granted for only one of INDO 201/202 or INDO 200. Recommended pre-requisites: one of INDO 101, INDO 102.

INDO 201.description: Study of the grammar and introduction to Indonesian literature. Credit will be granted for only one of INDO 201 or INDO 200. Recommended pre-requisite: INDO 101.

INDO 202.description: Continuation of INDO 201. Credit will be granted for only one of INDO 202 or INDO 200. Recommended pre-requisite: INDO 201.
